title: A new era begins
summary: A new web app, shared context for related conversations, and Core updates you can review and install when you choose.

highlights.title: A workspace for each project
highlights.body: Group conversations with a shared brief and resource references while keeping their histories separate.

highlights.title: Updates on your terms
highlights.body: Read release notes before updating my Core, follow installation progress, and keep your profiles separate from application code.

new: Browse conversations and project workspaces in the new web app.
Review and install published Core releases from the update dialog.
Explore activity and usage in your profile.
improvements: Stage verified Core archives before restarting the server.
Show measured download progress and profile preparation details during updates.
Keep accepted Core updates running when the browser page closes.
fixes: Preserve the working runtime when a replacement download or extraction fails.
